actions.fetch.description: Fetch a webpage and convert it to markdown format. Optionally render JavaScript, include raw HTML, or extract images.
actions.fetch.props.includeRawHtml.descr: Include the raw HTML in the response
actions.fetch.props.renderJs.description: Render JavaScript on the webpage before fetching
actions.fetch.props.url.description: The URL of the webpage to fetch
actions.search.description: Search the web for relevant content based on a natural language query. Perfect for grounding LLM responses with factual data.
actions.search.props.depth.description: Standard returns results faster; deep takes longer but yields more comprehensive results
actions.search.props.excludeDomains.desc: Domains to exclude from search results
actions.search.props.fromDate.descriptio: Start date for search results in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g., 2025-01-01
actions.search.props.includeDomains.desc: Domains to search within (up to 100 domains). Leave empty to search all domains.
actions.search.props.includeInlineCitati: Include inline citations in the answer. Only relevant when Output Type is "sourcedAnswer".
actions.search.props.includeSources.desc: Include sources in the response. Only relevant when Output Type is "structured".
actions.search.props.maxResults.descript: Maximum number of results to return
actions.search.props.outputType.descript: Format of the response. Use structured for custom JSON format.
actions.search.props.q.description: The natural language question or query to search for
actions.search.props.structuredOutputSch: JSON schema (as a string) for the desired response format. Required only when Output Type is "structured".
actions.search.props.toDate.description: End date for search results in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g., 2025-01-01
auth.description:
To get your API Key:

1. Go to your Linkup account dashboard
2. Navigate to API settings
3. Copy your API key
4. Paste it here
description: Linkup is a web search engine for AI apps. Connect your AI application to the internet and get grounding data to enrich your AI's output.
